content.title: Virginia Personal Injury Lawyers | Free Consultations
content.text: If you have suffered a personal injury due to someone else’s negligence, you may face mounting medical bills and be unable to work. Whether the injury arose from a car crash, slip and fall, workplace injury, or some other accident, Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers is here to help. Our skilled Virginia personal injury lawyers have decades of experience practicing personal injury law throughout Hampton Roads, and we have 9 different offices in the area, including Norfolk, Virginia Beach, and Portsmouth. We can get the compensation you deserve to move forward with your life. Contact us today to schedule your free consultation. Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers handles a range of personal injury claims. To win a personal injury claim in Virginia, you must prove that your injury is due to someone else’s negligence. A Virginia personal injury lawyer can help you substantiate your claim. At Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers, we’ll work to gather evidence to support your case. Our Virginia personal injury lawyers start building your case with a thorough investigation. We will assemble video and photo evidence documenting your injuries and the scene of the accident. If a police report is available, we will use it to substantiate facts and observations from law enforcement officers. We will also speak with witnesses who saw the accident and can attest to its chain of events. We will file all legal documents required to begin your lawsuit against the negligent individual or entity. We will also act on your behalf during interactions with insurance companies and other interested parties. Remember, it is critical to avoid providing a statement to any insurance company in the aftermath of a serious accident, especially if you are considering a lawsuit. Instead, rely on your legal counsel to communicate for you. Often, medical experts can provide strategic insights into the severity of your injury. Whether you experienced a broken arm or a spinal cord injury, the attorneys at Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers will reach out to doctors and physicians who can attest to the injuries you suffered, as well as what type of care you will need to recover fully. The attorneys at Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers have a broad range of personal injury law experience. As the Car Crash Experts, we are known for our legal prowess in vehicular claims. We also have expertise in unique personal injury cases, including Uber and Lyft claims and FELA railroad accidents. “Unfortunately, resolving the case takes a long time, much longer than you would like and much longer than all the lawyers and team members at Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers would like. The reason being is that you have to go ahead and get full medical treatment, usually taking months and months. After that, we gather everything we need: medical records, medical bills, the initial police investigation, private investigator investigation, so we can forward all of that to the other person’s insurance company that injured you. Then, they take time to review everything and get back with an offer. And then, we have to go back and forth because their offers are often terrible. We have to convince them why they are so terrible and get you a better offer. So, it does take time. We always ask people to be patient because here we want you to get the best results, which often does take some time. Per Va. Code § 8.01-34, courts will consider whether your own actions contributed to your injuries if your case proceeds to the courtroom. If your behavior somehow led to your injuries, even if you are not entirely at fault, the other party may use your actions to defend their own—potentially derailing your case. That is why it is so critical to work with an experienced lawyer who understands the intricacies of proving liability in a personal injury claim. Under Va. Code § 8.01-243, personal injury victims have two years from the date of the incident to file a claim. Exceptions apply in rare cases involving fraud, concealment, or some forms of medical malpractice. If you are considering a lawsuit, it is best to begin the process immediately so your legal team can assemble evidence. In the aftermath of an accident, you may be in shock. First, assess yourself and others involved and determine whether immediate medical care is necessary. If you need ambulatory transportation to a hospital, call 911 for assistance. People involved in automobile, bicycle, or pedestrian incidents can contact the police so they can manage the accident scene. Avoid giving any statements to insurance companies and seek an attorney’s advice if you are considering a legal claim. At Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers, there is no fee for an initial consultation. You can schedule a consultation with us to explain your case and explore your legal options at no cost to you. Many personal injury cases end in a settlement without the need for a trial. However, Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers will not shy away from a trial if we believe the negligent party isn’t offering you satisfactory compensation for your losses. Our results speak for themselves. Last year, we won the largest car crash verdict within the Virginia Commonwealth. We will not bill you by the hour when you work with Cooper Hurley Injury Lawyers. In fact, you will not owe a penny unless we successfully win your case. Even though you may not think you need to hire an attorney, consulting one is always wise. “The great thing about what I practice in personal injury law is that there’s no upfront cost. You can call us, talk to us, and there’s no cost. If we go ahead and help you with your injury from a car wreck, any cost associated with that, like investigation, getting medical records, having to pay doctors to chat with them, expert witnesses, things like that, we advance all that money. So, there’s no out-of-pocket money whatsoever. We do get paid when you get paid, so at the end of the day, our fee is based on the recovery, and we do get our costs back. But the nice thing is, initially, no money out of pocket by you. We do everything to help you, and there’s no advanced money out of pocket. It’s great for you.”
